issues.t: S3 GetObject omits the CRC32 full-object checksum headers for a Firehose-delivered object
CreateDeliveryStream's CompressionFormat ValidationException lists the enum value set out of the model's declared member order

firehose: 3 net-new causes — BufferingHints.IntervalInSeconds is ignored, the delivered object name carries an extra numeric segment, and dynamic partitioning with RecordDeAggregation/MetadataExtraction delivers nothing
firehose: the enum-constraint ValidationException for an out-of-enum ProcessorType lists the ProcessorType value set in the wrong order (1 cause)
firehose: IcebergDestinationDescription reports no materialised defaults for AppendOnly, BufferingHints, RetryOptions and S3BackupMode (2 causes)
firehose: Iceberg create/update validation misses the Glue table check and misstates three refusals (5 causes)
firehose: CreateDeliveryStream refuses a DirectPut create carrying KinesisStreamSourceConfiguration, cascading into Describe and Delete (3 causes)

firehose: the Splunk destination has no delivery path — a record put to a SplunkDestinationConfiguration stream is never attempted against the HEC endpoint and, under S3BackupMode FailedEventsOnly, never lands in the S3
firehose: CreateDeliveryStream does not validate ProcessingConfiguration — a Lambda processor with no LambdaArn parameter is accepted with HTTP 200 (1 cause)
firehose: S3DestinationConfiguration.BufferingHints is ignored for the long-interval case — a single PutRecord is flushed to S3 immediately instead of being held for IntervalInSeconds (1 cause)
firehose: DescribeDeliveryStream omits the legacy S3DestinationDescription and CreateDeliveryStream's no-destination refusal is misworded (2 causes)

firehose: 6 net-new root causes — BufferingHints are ignored and every record is flushed immediately, the delivery role is never authorized for the S3 write, CFN-deployed and Splunk-destination streams never back anythin

firehose: StopDeliveryStreamEncryption's not-found refusal reuses the control-plane-read sentence, so it reads "Firehose under account <id> not found." where AWS writes "Firehose under accountId <id> not found" (1 cause)
StartDeliveryStreamEncryption invents the ResourceInUseException message for a concurrent encryption change (1 cause)
firehose: CustomTimeZone is accepted and echoed but never applied — !{timestamp:...} and the automatic YYYY/MM/DD/HH prefix are always expanded in UTC (1 cause)
firehose: 2 net-new root causes — a KinesisStreamAsSource stream never ingests its source Kinesis stream (nothing reaches S3), and S3 delivery flushes before BufferingHints.IntervalInSeconds elapses
Firehose S3 delivery ignores BufferingHints, the destination role's permissions, CompressionFormat Content-Encoding, CustomTimeZone and the documented object-name suffix (5 causes)
Firehose: PutRecord accepted on KinesisStreamAsSource streams, CFN-deployed streams stay CREATING after CREATE_COMPLETE, and a just-created Kinesis source stream cannot be tagged (3 causes)
REOPENS: a CFN-deployed Firehose delivery stream never leaves CREATING, so PutRecord on it is refused after the stack reports CREATE_COMPLETE
Firehose ProcessingConfiguration echo omits the service-filled processor parameters, and PutRecord's not-active refusal message is built by the wrong rule (2 causes)
Firehose PutRecord/PutRecordBatch are accepted with 200 on a KinesisStreamAsSource delivery stream instead of being refused with InvalidArgumentException
Firehose never delivers buffered records to the S3 destination: PutRecord/PutRecordBatch mint RecordIds into an in-memory buffer that nothing ever flushes
Firehose TagDeliveryStream skips tag-key constraint validation and answers ResourceNotFoundException

Firehose control plane: configuration echo drops members, tag-key and KMS validation absent, destination-type-change misclassified, CFN deploys are inert, and rejection messages are re-worded (9 root causes)
Firehose UntagDeliveryStream drops every tag instead of only the keys named in TagKeys
Firehose argument validation admits invalid input and misclassifies rejections on stream create and encryption start

Firehose rejection messages are built by the wrong rules: values echoed, patterns anchored, account id dropped (6 causes)

Firehose DescribeDeliveryStream omits DeliveryStreamEncryptionConfiguration and destination defaults (2 causes)
Firehose CreateDeliveryStream/PutRecordBatch are overly permissive and misclassify rejections (7 causes)
CloudFormation-deployed Firehose delivery streams are never provisioned and the stack exposes no Outputs (2 causes)
